note: ON time = puntual, a la hora exacta. IN time = con tiempo de sobra.

spanish: a tiempo (con margen) / justo a tiempo
exampleEnglish: We got there in time for dinner.
exampleSpanish: Llegamos a tiempo para la cena (con margen).
note: IN time (for something) = antes de que sea tarde. Distinto de ON time (puntual).
AT night. Pero: IN the morning / IN the afternoon / IN the evening.

exampleEnglish: I drink coffee in the morning.
note: IN the morning / afternoon / evening. Excepción: AT night.
ON + días y fechas: on Monday, on July 4th. IN + meses y años: in July, in 2025.

exampleEnglish: I stay at home on Sundays.
exampleSpanish: Me quedo en casa los domingos.
note: AT home / at work / at school (sin 'the').

exampleSpanish: A ella le interesa la música.
note: interested IN (no 'interested on'). Después: interested in + -ing.

spanish: bueno en / se le da bien
note: good AT (something / doing something). Opuesto: bad AT.

exampleSpanish: Les tengo miedo a las arañas.
note: afraid OF (no 'afraid to' salvo 'afraid to do').
depend ON, no 'depend of'. 'It depends' se puede decir solo.

exampleEnglish: I listen to music every day.
note: listen TO. 'listen music' es un error muy común.

exampleEnglish: I wait for the bus here.
note: wait FOR. 'wait the bus' es un error.

exampleEnglish: I look for my keys every morning.
exampleSpanish: Busco mis llaves todas las mañanas.
note: look FOR = buscar. look AT = mirar. look AFTER = cuidar.

exampleEnglish: I think about you a lot.
note: think ABOUT / think OF. No 'think in'.
worry ABOUT. 'Don't worry about it' = no te preocupes.

exampleEnglish: She is married to a doctor.
exampleSpanish: Ella está casada con un doctor.
note: married TO, no 'married with'.
proud OF (something / someone / doing something).

exampleSpanish: El ejercicio es bueno para ti.
note: good FOR = beneficioso. good AT = habilidad.

exampleEnglish: This one is different from that one.
note: different FROM (EE. UU.). También se oye 'different than'.

exampleSpanish: Este libro me pertenece / es mío.
note: belong TO. No se usa en continuo: 'is belonging' es un error.
